purpose: Left-plane risk/evidence images for the home 'Bez nas / Z nami' risk carousel (regular-guest-stays variant). Each image is the unmanaged-risk situation; the matching 'Z nami' answer is text only (no second photo).
aspectRatio: 3:2 landscape (min 1800x1200); final crop tuned via CSS object-position
tone: Realistic southern Costa Blanca / Torrevieja apartment. White walls, tile or terrazzo floor, persiana shutters, warm Mediterranean daylight, occasional terrace glimpse. Premium but understated, never luxury staging. Documentary realism, quiet restrained mood. Operational/turnover energy, slightly faster than the private-use set, but NOT cheerful Airbnb marketing.
sharedNegativePrompt: people, faces, hands, body parts, text, lettering, numbers, watermark, logo, brand name, signage, UI, phone screen content, smiling hosts, real-estate-ad gloss, luxury glamour, HDR halos, oversaturation, fisheye, tilt-shift, cartoon, illustration, 3d render look, AI artifacts, distorted geometry, warped lines, duplicated objects, exaggerated disaster, flooding, fire, dramatic destruction, horror mold, generic cleaning-product stock photo
globalConstraints: No people and no pets anywhere in frame.
No readable text, screens, brand marks or signage.
Coherent single-source natural lighting; believable shadows.
Damage and mess must read as realistic and recent, not catastrophic.
Same apartment vocabulary across all four so the set feels like one property.

images.emotionalPurpose: Guests judge what they see on entry. A not-yet-reset apartment becomes a problem in the first minutes.
images.prompt: Interior photo of a small Costa Blanca holiday apartment immediately after guests have left and before it has been reset. Bed linen pulled back and crumpled, two used towels draped over a chair and the sofa arm, a couple of used drinking glasses on the coffee table, a cushion out of place, curtains half drawn. Warm late-morning light through persiana shutters. The room is not dirty, just clearly used and unprepared. Realistic, restrained, documentary.
images.focalPoint: the unmade bed / used towels in the mid-ground

images.emotionalPurpose: Damage after a stay disappears between messages and is found only when the next guest is already inside.
images.prompt: Close, low-key interior photo of a small post-stay damage detail in a Costa Blanca apartment: a pale ring stain and a fine scratch on a wooden side table near a wall, soft natural daylight. Quiet, undramatic, evidential. The kind of small fault that is easy to miss and easy to dispute later. Shallow depth of field, realistic texture.

images.emotionalPurpose: Without local structure the owner becomes the remote dispatcher of every turnover: keys, cleaners, access, questions.
images.prompt: Interior still life on a kitchen worktop in a Costa Blanca apartment: a small bunch of apartment keys with blank plain fob tags, a phone lying face-down, a folded cleaning cloth and a neutral spray bottle, a notepad with no readable writing. Implies coordination handled from a distance. Natural side light, calm composition, realistic, no branding.
images.focalPoint: the keys and face-down phone cluster

images.emotionalPurpose: One weak arrival costs more than cleaning: an unprepared property reads as a poor first impression.
images.prompt: Interior photo of the entrance and living area of a Costa Blanca apartment that feels unprepared for arrival: bare surfaces, a single key left on an empty table, an open empty cupboard, flat cool light, nothing made ready, a slightly stale and unwelcoming atmosphere. Restrained and realistic, not staged, conveying a weak first impression without any mess or damage.
